requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of product references for HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent name to minimize user confusion.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must reliably print on all current and new EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions as defined for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must operate correctly and without mechanical failure (e.g., input tray sensor flag) when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, tablecloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess whether the printer continues to function without failure when tilted 20 degrees left and right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must maintain print quality and operate reliably when printing while placed on a trolley.
